text:
Devon: Heads-up — I've been profiling long chat sessions and KV page residency keeps creeping up over time (memory growth ~3-5% per 10k tokens). Not an immediate OOM but concerns for multi-hour sessions.

Anya: Wow. Which metric showed it? eviction_count? fragmentation?

Devon: eviction_count doesn't fully explain it. I added a tiny sampler and saw many pages with 'stale' residency: resident=true but not accessed for >1M steps. Thinking fragmentation + prefix reuse pattern.

Sam: Any logs? can you paste sampler output?

Devon: pasted snippet:
```
shard=12 page_id=0x7f3a2 residency_ms=3600000 last_access=2026-03-01T12:34:56Z refs=1
shard=12 page_id=0x7f3a3 residency_ms=4200000 last_access=2026-03-01T10:01:22Z refs=0
```
looks like pages held because refs not cleared.

Li: Could be KV handle leak or delayed ref decrement on async IO path.

Devon: To debug I added a new metric 'kv_page_staleness_ratio' = (#pages idle>threshold) / total_pages. It trends up to 0.18 on long sessions. Also 'kv_fragmentation_ratio' (free_slots/total_slots) shows fragmentation.

Priya: Nice. Can you share PromQL?

Devon: sure:
```
# fraction of pages idle > 1h
sum(kv_page_idle_seconds_bucket{le=\"3600\"}) / sum(kv_page_total)

# eviction rate by shard
sum(irate(kv_evictions_total[5m])) by (shard)
```

Anya: we should add per-model and per-route labels. And add residency percentiles (p50/p90/p99).

Sam: Also capture 'reclaim_latency' when eviction frees memory, we saw delays.

InfraBot: Deploy queued: metrics/kv-observability v0.2 -> staging by @Devon

Devon: After adding labels, dashboard shows hotspot on shard 12 for model 'longchat-v2'.

Li: can you run a micro-repro locally? I can attach heap profiler.

Devon: repro steps:
```
make dev-serve && ./bin/runner --simulate-long-session --tokens 200000
curl -s localhost:9090/debug/kv/sampler > /tmp/kv-sample.log
```

Priya: I'll make a Grafana panel draft with these metrics: staleness_ratio, resid_percentiles, frac_evicted_per_min, reclaim_latency_hist.

Anya: Add alert: staleness_ratio > 0.12 for 10m => paging-ops-runbook. Also alert on per-shard eviction spikes.

Sam: Quick thought — batching heuristics could increase reuse for prefixes; maybe we can tweak early-commit to reduce fragmented pages. Adding to perf spike list.

Devon: filing a short RFC with timeline + suggested dashboards + repro. Will link here.

Devon: RFC link: https://redwood.internal/r/kv-page-staleness

Priya: LGTM. Next: add sample collector script to ops repo and create nightly job to run long-session sim and push metrics.
